correct_completion: she sent it to the editor.
full_sentence: Having finished the report, she sent it to the editor.
acceptable_variants: she emailed it to the editor the same day.
she submitted the document for review.

options.why_wrong: The participle clause 'having finished' needs a main clause with the same subject, the person who finished the report. Switching to an unrelated subject breaks this link.

options.text: she sent it to the editor.
the deadline was moved to Friday.
options.why_wrong: The main clause must describe the action of the person who finished the report, and this describes an unrelated event.
This describes a state, but it does not complete the sequence of actions that a participle clause introduces.

grammar_focus: Participle clauses with a shared subject
explanation: A participle clause at the start of a sentence describes an earlier action by the same subject as the main clause. The main clause must therefore continue with what that person did next.
translation: Skończywszy raport, wysłała go do redaktora.
